CFML Language Reference: Functions

Insert

Inserts a substring into a string after the specified character position.

Category

String functions

Syntax

Insert(substring, string, position)

Parameters

substring
The text to insert.
string
The string to insert it into.
position
The number of characters to keep before the inserted text. 0 inserts at the front; Len(string) appends at the end.

Returns

The new string.

Usage

A position less than 0 or greater than the length of the string causes an error. Note that the substring comes first, as with Find.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Phone = "6175551234">
<CFSET Pretty = Insert(") ", Phone, 3)>
<CFSET Pretty = Insert("-", Pretty, 8)>
<CFSET Pretty = Insert("(", Pretty, 0)>
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>Raw: #Phone#<BR>
Formatted: #Pretty#</P>
<P>Appending: #Insert(".cfm", "index", 5)#</P>
</CFOUTPUT>
